title: Canary crash and stress suite
blurb: A runner for every past crash, context loss and engine bug recorded in this project, alongside five tap-to-run stress tests that push 2D, WebGL 2, WebGPU, snapshots and DOM lifecycle paths, with one-click Markdown output for Chrome engineers.
question: Which past HTML-in-canvas crashes and engine bugs are fixed in Chrome Canary, and how do 2D, WebGL 2, WebGPU and snapshot paths hold up under heavy load?
result: Measured on 2026-11-24: two renderer crashes from Chrome 158 (removing an iframe inside paint, and adoptNode of a painted canvas) no longer crash in Chrome Canary 160.0.8180.0. startViewTransition() on a drawable child still crashes Canary 160, and continuous ctx.rotate() with drawElementImage() still drops lines of text on Apple Metal.
